visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a green t-shirt with a white mountain graphic stands on an outdoor street at night. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. Bright neon signs and blurred city lights are visible in the background. (2) A young woman with bangs, wearing a colorful floral vest over a white t-shirt, enters a building and stands at a wooden reception desk. The environment is a traditional clinic with wooden medicine drawers and shelving in the background. (3) The woman interacts with an older female receptionist in a maroon uniform. The lighting is bright and even. The camera captures her from the waist up as she gestures and speaks. (4) The woman is back outside at night, laughing and talking. Behind her, a sign board and a parked scooter are visible near the building entrance. (5) Inside the clinic, the camera focuses on a wall decorated with certificates and news clippings featuring a pastry chef. Several people wait in the lobby area. (6) A close-up shot of a hand swiping through a tablet screen, showing a digital menu of high-end French pastries with prices like 1500 and 230. (7) The woman holds a clear plastic shopping bag containing a white decorative box with gold patterns. She smiles at the camera, appearing satisfied with her purchase. (8) A close-up shot reveals the cake: a bronzed sphere with circular cutouts showing bright green sponge inside, topped with a white daisy. It is presented inside a gold-lined box. (9) In an indoor domestic setting, the woman holds the spherical cake and uses a golden spoon to cut it open, revealing layers of dark chocolate and cream. She tastes the cake and reacts with exaggerated surprised facial expressions.

Distant city traffic noise is audible. (2) A sharp digital 'ding' SFX marks a transition to a female voice whispering playfully. The BGM ducks, and the background ambience shifts to a quieter indoor room tone. (3) Field recording of a conversation between the host and clinic staff. Voices are clear but have slight room resonance. The BGM remains as a soft rhythmic layer. (4) A 'whoosh' transition SFX accompanies the female host's high-arousal laughter. The BGM volume increases, and outdoor night ambience returns as she speaks at a fast rate with rising intonations. (5) A magical, sparkling digital SFX plays as the BGM shifts to a more delicate, high-pitched synthesizer texture while the host admires pastries. (6) Sound of crinkling plastic triggers this phase as the host exclaims with high arousal. The BGM maintains its upbeat energy. (7) A percussive metallic clink of a spoon hitting a dish marks the tasting phase. The female voice becomes descriptive and analytical about the cake's flavor, accompanied by a subtle crunch sound from the pastry. BGM continues consistently.
